themes.theme: Floor & Decor Resilience vs. Growth Concerns

positions.commentary: It is considered a great company that trades like a great business with few identifiable business risks.
The speaker notes that Floor & Decor's professional business is about 45% of sales and that catering to pros has been great for their business.
